title: daily archive gets saved to internal storage
symptom: xDrip+ saves daily archive zip files to internal storage instead of external SD card, filling up internal storage and causing xDrip and AndroidAPS to crash or get stuck.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause; it suggests it may be an Android problem with storage mount points, and notes that xDrip once wrote to external storage but reverted to internal.
fix: No direct fix is provided in the thread. A workaround mentioned is using Nextcloud automatic upload to offload files, and later a Google Drive backup feature is mentioned as an alternative backup methodology.
evidence_quote: It looks like xdrip once *had* written to external storage (the "real" sdcard), but reverted to internal storage at some point in time.
